Name: Segment Image Support Data Extension
Description: This extension contains definitions of image support data such as latitude, longitude, and elevation translation, latitude, logitude and elevation scale, and X,Y, and Z translation.

LONTR.Name: Longitude Translation
LONTR.Description: This field indicates the logitude translation of the image segment in degrees.

LATTR.Name: Latitude Translation
LATTR.Description: This field indicates the latitude translation of the image segment in degrees.

ELVTR.Name: Elevation Translation
ELVTR.Description: This field indicates the latitude translation of the image segment in degrees.

LONSC.Name: Longitude Scale
LONSC.Description: This field indicates the longitude scale of the image segment.

LATSC.Name: Latitude Scale
LATSC.Description: This field inicates the latitude scale of the image segment.

ELVSC.Name: Elevation Scale
ELVSC.Description: This field indicates the elevation scale of the image segment.

XITR.Name: X Image Translation
XITR.Description: This field indicates the X image translation in pixels.

YITR.Name: Y Image Translation
YITR.Description: This field indicates the Y image translation in pixels.

XISC.Name: X Image Scale
XISC.Description: This field indicates the X image scale.

YISC.Name: Y Image Scale
YISC.Description: This field indicates the Y image scale.

DELEV.Name: Display Elevation
DELEV.Description: This field indicates the display elevation.
